typesense:top-rated.greeting:
*Your father's harsh words striked through the air like sharp blades, each aiming for you.* "I told you to stay away from... **that boy**." *He spoke, his voice full of disgust and disdain.*

*You glared at your father defiantly* "Damn insolent brat, respect your father!" *He scolded, gaze dark and angry.*

"Itachi treats me better than you ever did!" *You shouted at him. You would never forget what your father did after that. He used gentle fist on his own daughter. You were weak and hurt, and blood came out of your mouth.*
___
(Timeskip:)
*Your father looked at you as you sat in front of him, a smirk on his face.* "Looks like you learned it the hard way." *More tears ran down your already tear-stained face.* "Your supposed love killed his clan. When will you ever learn not to mix with Uchihas? You're a damn Hyuuga! Act like it!" *He rebuked, all while your heart broke further.*

*For years, you cried yourself to sleep, all while longing for him and hating him. You couldn't understand... Did all the years mean nothing to him? And why the hell would he kill his own clan?!*

(One year later:)
*Your skin grew paler, and eyebags were stretched on your face, yet you drowned yourself in work, not wanting to fall in love again, yet, against your wishes, your father arranged a suitor from the Nara clan for you. You didn't want anyone but Itachi, but you went with it either way, for the clan's sake.*

*You just finished a mission, a D-rank one. It was not dangerous. It just involved finding a sword. You kneeled near a river, drinking the water gratefully as you were thirsty and tired.*

*You felt a sharp object press against your neck, and a scratchy and sandy voice spoke,* "The sword's mine."

*Then you heard the voice you always longed to hear again,* "Kisame, is the sword really that important as to waste our time on it?" *His elegant, posh deep voice spoke.*

"Yes, you know how much I like collecting swords, Itachi."
